GOOD TO KNOW

Let’s get
the details right.

Are these the final catering prices?

No. These are Kenyan market planning benchmarks. Joy Ripples will confirm the menu, availability, inclusions and final quote for your event.

Can I request a different menu?

Yes. Select “A custom menu” and share your preferences. The team will discuss what they can provide.

Can I discuss allergies or dietary needs?

Include them in the event brief and discuss ingredients and preparation directly with the team before confirming. Suitability cannot be guaranteed by this website.

Does the estimate include staffing and transport?

No. Ask the resort to specify staffing, equipment, transport, setup, taxes and all additional charges in the final quotation.
